items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: And Mr. Roosevelt won the election which made all of us feel as though we had a big hand in his Victory.

ctx.x: When we hit the road and played Boston, the show was picketed and there was an effort made to close the show. There was almost a panic in the theatre when someone shot off a bunch of fire crackers, but the show continued.

We were doing one night stands and played Chicago, Indianapolis, Milwaukee, Minneapolis, St. Louis and some cities that I've forgotten as we were moving around so fast. The last performance was in New York city the 30th of October at Manhattan Centre. The show was a big success everywhere and Adam Clayton Powell Jr. made a speech at Manhattan Centre before the show started which put everybody in high gear. And Mr. Roosevelt won the election which made all of us feel as though we had a big hand in his Victory.
